meta.title: Photnoo — Private photo delivery for photographers
meta.description: Deliver every shoot in a private gallery with a link and password, a 7-day window and proof of every download. Built for photographers in Egypt.

hero.title: Deliver photos your clients will remember.
hero.subtitle: Private galleries with a link and password, a 7-day window, and proof of every download.
hero.imageAlt: A bride and groom embracing on a Cairo rooftop at golden hour, the Nile and minarets behind them.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Every gallery opens only with its link and a password you send separately.

window.title: Open for 7 days
window.body: Clients get a clear window to download. After it closes, the files are deleted.

proof.title: Proof of every download
proof.body: See who opened the gallery, on which device, and every photo they downloaded.

how.title: From memory card to client in three steps
how.subtitle: No folders to zip, no drive links to chase. Upload once and let Photnoo handle delivery.

upload.title: Upload the shoot
upload.body: Drag in JPG, RAW, TIFF or PSD files up to 2 GB each. Uploads resume if the connection drops.

share.title: Share on WhatsApp
share.body: Send the private link and the password as two separate messages, straight from the gallery.

proof.title: See every download
proof.body: Every view and download is recorded, so "I never got the photos" is settled in seconds.

demo.linkMessage: Your gallery from Mona Adel Photography is ready

clients.title: A gallery your client opens in one tap
clients.body: Your clients never make an account or install an app. They open the link on their phone, enter the password, and see your work at its best.

points.noApp: No app, no account, works on any phone
points.fullscreen: Full-screen viewer with swipe and zoom
points.download: Download one photo or the whole shoot

clients.phoneAlt: A phone showing a client gallery with engagement photos.

pricing.title: Simple plans, priced in EGP
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes every feature. Choose how much you deliver in a year.
pricing.f3: Proof of every view and download
pricing.f4: Pay by InstaPay, Vodafone Cash or bank transfer
pricing.enterprise: Delivering more than 2 TB a year?
pricing.note: Photnoo is invite-only while we onboard photographers in Egypt. Request access and we'll reply within two working days.

client.q: What does my client need to open the gallery?
client.a: Only the link and the password you send them. There is no account and no app; it works in any phone or computer browser.

expiry.a: The link closes and the files are deleted from our servers. You can see everything the client did before it closed.

allowance.q: Why is there a download allowance?
allowance.a: Each gallery can be downloaded up to twice its size. It stops a link from being passed around while giving your client room to download again.

files.a: JPG, PNG, TIFF, PSD, ZIP and the common RAW formats (CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, ORF, RW2), up to 2 GB per file.

pay.a: Pick a plan, send the amount by InstaPay, Vodafone Cash or bank transfer with your payment reference, and upload the receipt. We confirm it and email your invoice.

privacy.q: Can Photnoo staff see my photos?
privacy.a: No. Our team sees gallery names, sizes and dates only. Photos are opened only for a logged abuse report.

cta.title: Deliver your next shoot with Photnoo
cta.body: Join the photographers in Egypt who deliver privately, on time, with proof.
cta.imageAlt: A bride and her family smiling at her wedding photos on a phone in a sunlit Cairo living room.

footer.tagline: Private photo delivery for professional photographers.
